title: Greece Wedding Packages and What They Include
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW guide (not a refresh). Explainer on what Greek venue wedding packages include, leave out and how to compare them like for like, using what venues publish about their own packages. Same official-sources-only method as content/posts/greece-wedding-venues and content/posts/crete-wedding-venues. NO prices, fees, euro or AUD figures, 'from' prices or percentages anywhere.

OVERLAP: commercial pages /destination-wedding-packages ('All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages'), /destination-packages and the Greece hub /destinations/europe/greece. SEO checks whether any ranks for 'greece wedding packages' and variants (santorini, mykonos, crete wedding packages, all inclusive wedding packages greece, greek island wedding packages). If one ranks, this is the editorial explainer linking to it prominently; the run report recommends how they split the keyword. Nothing on the live site changes. Do not touch content/posts/italy-wedding-packages.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; myths sections; 'you will often read'). Customs without a strong source are written as living practice in a confident voice ('Many couples...'), never with a meaning or origin stated as fact. 'Often told' at most once per post, never 'it is often told that'. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section. Source gaps go in the run report only. No per-line source credits (never 'Britannica describes', 'the museum holds', 'the study records'). No myth-busting lines ('you will often read', 'confident dates').

Package facts: reuse and re-check live the package facts already sourced in content/posts/greece-wedding-venues/03-source-pack*.json and content/posts/crete-wedding-venues/03-source-pack.json (Elounda Beach indicative package, Nana Princess named packages, Abaton 2025-2026 terms, Elounda Collection civil/Orthodox/symbolic packages incl. 40-day registration, Euphoria, Amirandes), plus Santorini, Mykonos, Rhodes, Corfu, Athens Riviera and Peloponnese venues' own package pages. Each inclusion tied to the venue that publishes it.

Sections: what a Greek venue package usually includes; ceremony type inside a package (civil, Greek Orthodox, symbolic; legal meaning only as sources state it; link the Greece guide's legal section); what packages often leave out (only where a venue states it: exclusive-use hire, guest rooms, transfers, extra hours, outside suppliers, document fees; written as questions; 'a fee applies' only where a source says so); venue package vs planner vs building your own (practical, no competitor claims); how to compare two quotes like for like (checklist, no figures); Australian angle (currency of the quote, deposits and cancellation terms as questions, Smartraveller insurance).
Sources: venues' official websites, package pages and brochures; Smartraveller; the Australian Embassy Athens. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, review sites or Wikipedia.

Links: /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-venues (draft), /destination-weddings/crete-wedding-venues (draft), /destinations/europe/greece, /destination-wedding-packages and /destination-packages (if SEO confirms relevance), /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions (draft, once), /expert-advice/what-is-included-in-lake-como-wedding-packages (sister explainer, if natural), /wonderland-concierge, /magazine. UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=greece-wedding-packages&utm_content=primary|secondary|magnet|closing.
Images: placeholders only; venue images licensed or press kit with permission only; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding; competitor images reference-only.

Speed: Apify web-fetch and DataForSEO. Fact-check as 2 parallel batches (A: re-check Crete and Greece guide package facts plus Santorini and Mykonos package pages, fact_01+; B: Rhodes, Corfu, Athens Riviera, Peloponnese package pages, legal facts re-checked, Smartraveller insurance, fact_100+), 15 min HARD by the clock, no new reads after the limit, save after every 3 facts, scratch folders grp_a/grp_b; self_qa.confidence a number; must_include_coverage objects with covered_by arrays; never retry a declined call.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md (quotes in AUD; fee agreed in writing before work begins; inclusions confirmed in writing; single point of contact; works in your time zone; plans venue, travel, vendors and payments); nothing on legal, church or religious paperwork; no Wedded Privileges.

Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed where a venue's package is described, no planner or other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
